parameters.query:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT pu.id AS user_id, pv.tipo_vehiculo
  FROM public.parqueadero_usuarios pu
  JOIN public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv ON pv.id = $2::bigint
    AND pv.parqueadero_usuario_id = pu.id
    AND pv.activo = TRUE
  WHERE pu.id = $1::bigint AND pu.estado = 'ACTIVO'
), configured_modality AS (
  SELECT pm.id, pm.modalidad, pm.precio
  FROM public.parqueadero_modalidades pm
  JOIN eligible e ON e.tipo_vehiculo = pm.tipo_vehiculo
  WHERE pm.modalidad = $3 AND pm.activo = TRUE AND pm.precio IS NOT NULL
), inserted_payment AS (
  INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_pagos (
    parqueadero_usuario_id, modalidad_id, monto, metodo_pago, referencia, fecha_pago,
    fecha_inicio, fecha_fin, estado, registrado_por
  )
  SELECT
    e.user_id, cm.id, cm.precio, $5, NULLIF($6, ''), now(), $4::date,
    CASE WHEN cm.modalidad = 'MENSUAL' THEN $4::date + 29 ELSE $4::date END,
    $7, $9::bigint
  FROM eligible e
  CROSS JOIN configured_modality cm
  RETURNING id, parqueadero_usuario_id, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin, estado, monto
), inserted_authorization AS (
  INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_autorizaciones (parqueadero_usuario_id, pago_id, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin, estado)
  SELECT parqueadero_usuario_id, id, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin, 'VIGENTE'
  FROM inserted_payment
  WHERE estado = 'APROBADO' AND $8::boolean = TRUE
  RETURNING id, codigo
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT TRUE FROM inserted_payment LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS success,
  (SELECT id::int FROM inserted_payment LIMIT 1) AS id,
  (SELECT monto::double precision FROM inserted_payment LIMIT 1) AS amount,
  (SELECT id::int FROM inserted_authorization LIMIT 1) AS "authorizationId",
  (SELECT codigo::text FROM inserted_authorization LIMIT 1) AS "authorizationCode",
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible) THEN 'El usuario o vehículo no existe, está inactivo o no corresponde al usuario.'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM configured_modality) THEN 'No existe una tarifa activa para esta modalidad y tipo de vehículo.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible) THEN 404
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM configured_modality) THEN 409
    ELSE 201
  END AS "statusCode";

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, id: $json.id, amount: $json.amount, authorizationId: $json.authorizationId, authorizationCode: $json.authorizationId ? 'YV-' + String($json.authorizationId).padStart(6, '0') : null } }}
